opId.description: A unique ID for this call. Reuse it only when retrying the same call.

category.description: product: What should it do? (scope, behaviour, priorities, who it's for); design: How should it look, feel or read? (screens, flows, wording); engineering: How should it be built? (architecture, libraries, trade-offs); business: Is it allowed / what's the policy? (pricing, legal, policy, customers, commitments); access: I need something I can't get myself (keys, accounts, permissions, data, a service turned on); other: Anything else (everything else, and Claude Code's AskUserQuestion)

topic.description: One of the project's topics from your briefing, when the question is about one
